scope: credential-free public surfaces only: no account creation, no credentials, no payments; robots.txt absolute; auth walls recorded, never bypassed

checks.title: MCP server documented at a public docs page
checks.detail: https://docs.stripe.com/mcp.md -> HTTP 200 markdown naming the hosted endpoint mcp.stripe.com

checks.title: Hosted MCP endpoint answers a JSON-RPC initialize
checks.detail: initialize answered with the MCP authorization challenge (HTTP 401 + WWW-Authenticate resource_metadata) — a live server speaking the protocol auth spec

checks.title: RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata is served and well-formed
checks.detail: oauth-protected-resource metadata is valid JSON with 1 authorization server(s)

checks.title: Malformed request answered with a structured error, not HTML
checks.detail: malformed JSON rejected with HTTP 401 and a JSON error body

checks.title: tools/list returns schema-valid tool definitions
checks.detail: tools/list sits behind the OAuth wall (HTTP 401): the tool-schema lint needs an authorized session, so it is not reachable credential-free — recorded, not bypassed

checks.title: Agent task trial through the MCP server
checks.detail: L4 requires an OAuth-scoped sandbox workspace for an agent to do real work through the server (program §3, Phase 3 infrastructure); not reachable credential-free

checks.title: Sustained, adversarial, long-horizon use
checks.detail: L5 requires repeated authenticated trials over time (program §1); not reachable credential-free

unverified.detail: tools/list sits behind the OAuth wall (HTTP 401): the tool-schema lint needs an authorized session, so it is not reachable credential-free — recorded, not bypassed

checks.title: API reference served as agent-readable markdown
API origin resolves and answers an unauthenticated request
checks.detail: robots.txt disallows every candidate URL for our user agent (https://api.stripe.com/)

checks.title: Unauthenticated resource request returns the documented error envelope
checks.detail: robots.txt disallows every candidate URL for our user agent (https://api.stripe.com/v1/charges)

checks.title: Error envelope is consistent across endpoints, including unknown paths
checks.detail: robots.txt disallows every candidate URL for our user agent (https://api.stripe.com/v1/customers, https://api.stripe.com/v1/ultrametric-depth-nonexistent)

checks.title: Published OpenAPI spec retrieves and is structurally valid
checks.detail: OpenAPI 3.0.0 from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/openapi/master/openapi/spec3.json: 431 paths, 612 operations (all with responses), 1538 component schemas, error envelope declared

checks.title: llms.txt conforms: plain text indexing markdown doc mirrors
checks.detail: llms.txt -> HTTP 200, 92764 bytes indexing 471 .md doc mirrors

checks.title: Documented rate limits enforced and reported via headers
checks.detail: rate limits are enforced per authenticated credential; observing enforcement would mean hammering the unauthenticated endpoint, which only ever answers 401 — not reachable credential-free

checks.title: Repeated writes with the idempotency header dedupe
checks.detail: idempotent writes require an authenticated sandbox credential; not reachable credential-free

checks.title: Agent task trial against a sandbox account
checks.detail: L4 requires a disposable sandbox account and scoped test credentials (program §3, Phase 3 infrastructure); not reachable credential-free

checks.title: Sustained, adversarial, long-horizon use
checks.detail: L5 requires repeated authenticated trials over time (program §1); not reachable credential-free

unverified.detail: robots.txt disallows every candidate URL for our user agent (https://api.stripe.com/)
